name: Music
tagline: The music on your devices, and the catalogues that have more

offers.label: Session
offers.description: The session this app plays through: the one it has, or one made now. It is kept both in

offers.label: Open link
offers.description: Opens a `music://` link: the song it names plays, and the album, artist or playlist it names

offers.label: Lyrics now
offers.description: Asks for the words of what plays, keeping the session it asks for.

offers.label: Search
offers.description: Asks the catalogue for the songs, albums, artists and playlists a query finds.

offers.label: Refresh
offers.description: Asks the catalogue for its home page.

offers.label: Note failure
offers.description: Says why the player stopped, and where, so the notice names the place and continues there.

offers.label: Try again
offers.description: Asks the catalogue for the song's address again and plays it on from where it stopped: a

offers.label: New mixtape
offers.description: Makes a playlist of the person's own: at Spotify too, when it is their catalogue and their

offers.label: Set catalogue
offers.description: Chooses which catalogue the app asks.

offers.label: Connect Spotify
offers.description: Connects the person's Spotify: the page they sign in on is shown in the Spotify section.

offers.label: I signed in
offers.description: Takes the sign-in the person gave on Spotify's page.

offers.label: Disconnect Spotify
offers.description: Forgets this device's Spotify sign-in.

offers.label: Refresh devices
offers.description: Reads the places Spotify plays on.

offers.label: Play on Spotify
offers.description: Plays `uri` on Spotify, where it plays: empty plays what was playing.

offers.label: Pause on Spotify
offers.description: Pauses what plays on Spotify.

offers.label: Next on Spotify
offers.description: Plays what follows on Spotify.

offers.label: Previous on Spotify
offers.description: Plays what played before on Spotify.

offers.label: What plays on Spotify
offers.description: Reads what plays on Spotify now.

offers.label: Read Spotify's queue
offers.description: Reads what plays next on Spotify: its own queue, which is shown here and never edited here.

offers.label: More from Spotify
offers.description: Asks Spotify for one more page of what the person keeps there.

offers.label: Update taste
offers.description: Turns one of the recommendations' switches.
